name: Background Studio
pitch: Removes backgrounds from hundreds of scans and photos at once, offline, without tearing tickets or stamps apart.
problem: AI cut-out tools tear printed tickets and stamps apart.

stats.label: network connections once it's set up
categories, each on its own key

features.title: Fine-tune any image
features.text: Compare before and after, then fix edges, straighten, crop or touch up.
details: Brushes to keep or erase by hand
Copy one image's settings onto the next
Save and go to the next, through a whole folder

screen.alt: The editor on a theatre ticket: the scan on the left of a slider, the cut-out on a checkerboard on the right, and Method, Edges and Straighten controls beside it

features.title: Sort and tag
features.text: File pictures into your own categories, one key press each.
details: Suggests a category and learns from every tag
Then copy into folders, Finder tags or a spreadsheet

screen.alt: Sorting a Vespa sticker: categories Tickets, Stamps, Stickers, Postcards and Souvenirs on the right with their keys, and a suggestion that reads Looks like Stickers, 92%

features.title: Made for scans
features.text: Auto-detect picks a method per scan: cut-out, ink only, or keep as is.
details: Fills a ticket's outline so nothing printed is lost
Keeps a stamp's ink and drops the paper
Leaves a postcard that fills the scan alone

features.title: Private by design
features.text: Open-source models run on your Mac; your images never leave it.
details: Originals are only read, never changed
Results can go straight to Photobook Studio's Shelf

screens.alt: Background Studio's results: eight scans cut out on a checkerboard, from stamps and stickers to two tickets, with the postcard kept as is
screens.caption: Eight scans of trip keepsakes, done in ten seconds
